name: maxio-sdk
description: Install and consume the Maxio Advanced Billing .NET SDK, grounded in a bundled SDK map. The integrate-maxio workflow skill plans a map-grounded contract sheet before any code is written, implements from it, and fixes SDK compile/build errors map-first — cloning the SDK source only when the map cannot settle a fact. Includes the maxio-getting-started map and the seven dotnet-* companion skills. No MCP server.
